$comment: Authored allowlist for scripts/docs/check-examples.mjs check B (dependency completeness).
A docs snippet may only import a bare package that appears here — otherwise the reader
is being asked to install something the page never declared. Add a package only when a
docs page genuinely needs it, and keep the note: it is the justification a reviewer reads.
Relative specifiers, `@theme-kit/*`, Node builtins and URL imports are handled by the check.
